create_class_muladd: create a MulAdd class instance that fuses elementwise mul and add operations
run_forward_native: run the forward_native method of MulAdd with torch tensors a, b, c and optional integer k
run_forward_cuda: run the forward_cuda method of MulAdd using Triton's fuse_scale_shift_kernel for GPU acceleration
run_forward_xpu: run the forward_xpu method of MulAdd falling back to native PyTorch computation for XPU devices
test_forward_native: test the forward_native method of MulAdd with 4-D tensor b for frame-aware reshaping and 3-D tensor b for standard broadcasting
